analysis.qualification: Fixed500calibration queries and3processes per implementation; paired geometric ratios of20-round query/process medians. Crossed bootstrap intervals conditional on this set/session; no held-out/general-input/serving-tail inference. P95 describes query/process medians, not request latency tail. Sampled GPU peaks, C++ tracked allocations and Torch allocator peaks have different scopes; no claim that any is an exact physical peak.
